in_sanskrit.name: Afrid
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Afrid एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Apruv', meaning 'God's Grace'. Afrid is a name that carries the blessings of the divine. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the grace of the gods bestows wisdom and strength upon those who bear this name.
